locations.name: Gale Crater
locations.summary: A net of ridges left behind by groundwater on the slope of Mount Sharp. Curiosity has been working here since 2025.
locations.detail: The map covers 2 × 2 km at 2 m per pixel, with 458 m of relief. It has 31 data layers, 8 science targets and 3 walking plans.

locations.name: Jezero Crater
locations.summary: The fan of an ancient river delta on the floor of Jezero crater, where Perseverance collects rock samples for return to Earth.
locations.detail: The map covers 2 × 2 km at 2 m per pixel, with 121 m of relief. It has 28 data layers, 7 science targets and 3 walking plans.
